text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions at gains, but feeling good about locking them in is not evidence that selling was the best choice; I should decide based on their current prospects.","I should assess each stock in the context of my whole portfolio, rather than treating it as a separate account or anchoring on my average cost.","Doing nothing can be reasonable, but I should not let reluctance to trade replace a deliberate review; past price moves alone do not predict future ones."]}
